hint: WriteProtection.SetPassword only restricts editing, it does NOT encrypt the file. The document remains fully readable without a password. For true encryption use OoxmlSaveOptions { Password = "..." } or DocSaveOptions { Password = "..." } passed to doc.Save().

Mustache-style {{field}} placeholders require doc.MailMerge.UseNonMergeFields = true; set this immediately before the Execute() or ExecuteWithRegions() call, otherwise the placeholders are treated as plain text and no substitution occurs.

Building a watermark by manually constructing a Shape with ShapeType.TextPlainText is the pre-19.2 approach. Use the dedicated Watermark class: doc.Watermark.SetText(text, new TextWatermarkOptions { FontFamily = "Arial", FontSize = 40, Color = Color.LightGray, Layout = WatermarkLayout.Diagonal }).

Saving to a MemoryStream and then calling File.WriteAllBytes buffers the entire document in RAM. For large documents use a FileStream directly: new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create) and pass it to doc.Save(stream, format).

Setting LoadOptions.LoadFormat alone has no effect on memory usage. To reduce peak memory when loading large documents set MemoryOptimization = true in the LoadOptions initializer: new LoadOptions { LoadFormat = ..., MemoryOptimization = true }. For documents too large to process in RAM, also set LoadOptions.TempFolder and SaveOptions.TempFolder to a disk path.
Removing blank pages by counting pages or iterating rendered output is error-prone. Use the built-in doc.RemoveBlankPages() method — it is the dedicated single-call API for this task.

Processing a document section-by-section or page-by-page does NOT reduce peak memory footprint. The entire DOM is loaded on Document construction regardless of iteration strategy. To reduce memory use LoadOptions.MemoryOptimization = true and set LoadOptions.TempFolder / SaveOptions.TempFolder for overflow to disk.

DigitalSignatureUtil.Sign() creates a PKCS#7 signature on a DOCX package; it does NOT produce a cryptographically signed PDF when the file is later saved as PDF. Use PdfSaveOptions.DigitalSignatureDetails with a CertificateHolder to embed a digital signature directly in the PDF output.
correction: Replace the PDF save step with: var pdfOptions = new PdfSaveOptions { DigitalSignatureDetails = new PdfDigitalSignatureDetails(CertificateHolder.Create("certificate.pfx", "password"), "Signing Reason", "Location", DateTime.Now) }; doc.Save("SignedDocument.pdf", pdfOptions);

hint: Removing blank pages by iterating rendered page ranges with ExtractPages() is fragile and memory-heavy. Use the built-in doc.RemoveBlankPages() method — it is the dedicated single-call API for this task.
correction: Replace the entire page-iteration approach with: doc.RemoveBlankPages(); doc.Save(outputPath);
